findings.text: _recorded_role re-implements the role-from-record read that reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:1003 (_pointer_role, re-exported as reckon.crew.recovery._pointer_role) already owns and that dispatch_sessions.py:1612 states in the same module; it duplicates rather than extends the owner and could be _pointer_role(record) or IMPLEMENT_ROLE.

The three implement-role cases assert a value equal to launch_plan's own default, so they stay green under the recorded mutation (3 failed, 3 passed) and cannot catch a call site that stops threading the role for implement nodes; only the three review cases discriminate the regression.

justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_launch_records_its_nodes_role.py drives the direct, queued-admission and resume routes and the manifest records its 6 passed at head plus the scoped gate's 64 passed.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's existing idiom of one small record-reading helper beside _recorded_task_node and a recorded dimension beside the others at worker_behaviour.py:59.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/worker_behaviour.py:64 records the role and reckon/crew/dispatching/launch.py:766 plus dispatch_sessions.py:1502,1640 pass it on all three launch routes, which is what the goal asks.
